endorsements.name: Jon Chittenden
endorsements.label: Untwining Twine
endorsements.description: Over 14 years ago, Kevin Ashton was the first to coin the term "internet of things," and pointed out that data on the Internet is mostly created by humans. Things have changed considerably since 1999 - Lou Bega's Mambo No. 5 is no longer on the radio, many appliances ship with embedded systems that can be remotely monitored, and the smart home is something we're all excited for and terrified of.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2013
